data.name: Hidden Boston: Tales, Tidbits, and Treasures
data.description:
On this captivating walking tour, you will uncover Boston's hidden stories and quirky secrets. Step off the beaten path and journey into the city's lesser-known corners, where fascinating tales of historical events, local legends, and curious trivia await.

 What to Expect:

-   Engaging stories that reveal Boston's character, from its revolutionary past to modern-day quirks.
-   Hidden gems and landmarks you won't find in guidebooks.
-   A fun and interactive experience, perfect for history buffs, trivia lovers, and anyone who loves a good story.

Whether you're a first-time visitor or a seasoned local, this tour promises to surprise and delight you with the unique charm of Boston's untold tales.

We will start offering this tour in English only. The tour will be offered on Tuesdays and Thursdays at noon.
data.what_is_included: - The Hidden Boston tour begins at the iconic Boston Public Garden, right next to the charming Make Way for Ducklings sculptures. These beloved statues, inspired by the classic children's book, are a perfect spot for a photo op before we embark on an exploration of the city's lesser-known gems. From here, we’ll take you on a journey through the hidden corners and secret history of Boston, uncovering stories and locations that many visitors overlook.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellation of a reservation must be made at least 72 hours prior to tour to qualify for a full refund. 
50% refund between 48-72 hours. No refunds will be issued within 48 hours of a tour. 

Full refund if you cancel anytime due to certain unforeseeable events: These include travel restrictions imposed by governments, war, civil insurrection, strike, extreme weather, earthquake or natural disaster; circumstances where a cruise ship cannot dock, or flight to your destination is cancelled. Please note this does not include personal or family illness or injury, poor weather or a change of plans.
